entries.Original: (Core logic, event capturing, and data structures)
entries.Translated: （伊甸内核逻辑、事件捕获与数据结构）

entries.Original: (Canvas engine, drawing tools, network, and rendering)
entries.Translated: （画布引擎、绘图工具、网络与渲染）

entries.Original: Opens the GitHub Issues page in your browser.
entries.Translated: 在浏览器中打开 GitHub Issues 页面。
捐赠并支持回放与规划功能。

entries.Original: Right click and drag to move this overlay. Moves full snapped group if top-left is dragged.
entries.Translated: 右键拖动可移动此悬浮窗。拖动左上角时会移动整个吸附组。

entries.Original: - Powered by Death Recap by Kouzukii and AetherDraw by rail
entries.Translated: - 由 Kouzukii 的 Death Recap 与 rail 的 AetherDraw 提供支持

entries.Original: Capture current state as a slide
entries.Translated: 将当前状态捕获为幻灯片
打开 Aether Blackbox 设置

entries.Original: Preview and adjust the Party/Alliance overlay layout
entries.Translated: 预览并调整小队/团队悬浮窗布局

entries.Original: No slides staged. Open a replay and click the Camera icon to capture a slide.
entries.Translated: 暂无幻灯片。打开回放并点击相机图标以捕获幻灯片。

entries.Original: Test if different mitigations could have prevented a death.
entries.Translated: 测试不同的减伤是否能避免死亡。
使用绝对落潮密道时间

entries.Original: Left click and drag corner to scale overlay
entries.Translated: 左键拖动角落以缩放悬浮窗

entries.Original: Right click and drag to move this overlay
entries.Translated: 右键拖动以移动此悬浮窗

entries.Original: Please wait, may take up to a minute as server boots from inactivity. 24/7 uptime servers aren't free sadly.
entries.Translated: 请稍候，服务器因闲置而启动，可能需要长达一分钟。很遗憾，24/7 全天候服务器并非免费。

entries.Original: Creates a secure room for your current party using a hash of your Party ID. All party members must click this to be in the same quick sync room.
entries.Translated: 使用小队 ID 的哈希值为当前小队创建安全房间。所有小队成员都必须点击此项才能进入同一个快速同步房间。

entries.Original: You must be in a party to use this option.
entries.Translated: 你必须处于小队中才能使用此选项。

entries.Original: Create or join a session using a shared passphrase. For cross-world/alliance groups. The generated passphrase should give you plausible deniability if accidentaly typed in open chat. Or make up your own code/phrase.
entries.Translated: 使用共享口令创建或加入会话。适用于跨服/团队编组。生成的口令即使不小心在公开聊天中打出也能让你有合理的推脱理由。或者自己编一个代码/短语。

entries.Original: Modify the shape using the Main Canvas and Properties Window. When finished, save the changes below.
entries.Translated: 使用主画布和属性窗口修改形状。完成后，在下方保存更改。
将画布修改保存到机制

entries.Original: On cooldown at time of death.
Buy me a coffee if this plugin helped your prog!
entries.Translated: 如果这个插件对你的开荒有帮助，请我喝杯咖啡吧！

entries.Original: Locked objects cannot be selected or moved on the canvas.
entries.Translated: 已锁定的对象无法在画布上选中或移动。

entries.Original: Replaces player names with their Job Abbreviation (e.g., 'WAR', 'WHM') in replays.
entries.Translated: 在回放中将玩家名称替换为其职业缩写 (例如 'WAR'、'WHM')。

entries.Original: Shows or hides the draggable party member overlay in the main replay view.
entries.Translated: 在主回放视图中显示或隐藏可拖动的队员悬浮窗。

entries.Original:
Automatically deletes replay files older than this (in days) upon plugin startup.
Set to 0 to disable auto-cleanup.
Replays are located in AppData-Roaming-XIVLauncher-pluginconfigs-AetherBlackbox
entries.Translated:
插件启动时自动删除早于该天数的回放文件。
设为 0 以禁用自动清理。
回放位于 AppData-Roaming-XIVLauncher-pluginconfigs-AetherBlackbox

entries.Original:
Filter category of the "Chat Message" death notification.
"Debug" will show up in all chat tabs regardless of configuration.
Note that this will only affect the way the notification is displayed to you. They will never be visible to others.
entries.Translated:
“聊天消息”死亡通知的过滤类别。
无论配置如何，“调试”都会显示在所有聊天标签页中。
注意，这只会影响通知向你显示的方式。其他人永远看不到它们。

entries.Original: Prints the command in the chat to reopen the window the first time you close.
entries.Translated: 首次关闭窗口时，在聊天中输出可重新打开该窗口的命令。

entries.Original: Will only show a death notification when in an instance (e.g. a Dungeon)
entries.Translated: 仅在副本中（例如迷宫）显示死亡通知

entries.Original: [AetherBlackbox] Buffs/debuffs are currently not being tracked due to patch updates, but positions and actions should work.
entries.Translated: [AetherBlackbox] 由于版本更新，增益/减益目前无法追踪，但位置和动作应该可以正常工作。
